subject: Forecast stability checklist and Exec Kit intake
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.inference>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast stability checklist and Exec Kit intake

Hi all,

We have BrightWave's leadership review next week and Finance asked us to ship an "Exec Kit" by EOD Friday so the CFO can review changes before the QBR. Goal: a compact packet (1 page rollup + 2-slide deal summary per net-new commit) and a short stability checklist for each stage where we saw movement.

Ask: please open the attached checklist, add your stage-level updates for any deals you own (especially Stage 3->4 or Stage 4->Commit moves), and drop a 1-line rationale for each change. Key items we need:
- Confirmed commit amount (ARR)
- True close probability used for commit tally
- Any gating issues (legal/Security/Procurement)
- Suggested talking point for execs (1 sentence)

Deadlines:
- Updates due by Thu 5/20 10:00 PT (so I can assemble and route to Lauren)
- Final exec packet will be sent to BrightWave and our execs Fri 5/21 12:00 PT

Attachments: forecast_stability_checklist.xlsx (xlsx) — please only edit your rows. exec_kit_template.pdf (pdf) — Lauren will assemble.

If you have questions or need me to pull raw pipeline slices, ping me and I can run the gating query.

Thanks,
Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.inference>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast stability checklist and Exec Kit intake

Thanks Lukas — I'm on it. Quick notes as I'm scanning:
- I moved two deals in Stage 3 to Stage 4 after legal confirmed data residency for EU nodes (rows 71, 88).
- For commit math, I'm using our conservative probability (80% for Stage 4 unless AE confirms higher).
- I'll flag any procurement holds I see and include the expected procurement contact.

I'll have my sheet updated by Wed EOD and will add the single-sentence talking points per deal.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Looping in Sara from BrightWave so they can confirm timing for their side of the review (Sara, hi — can you confirm the 5/21 12:00 PT executive window still works for you?).

Internal note: two quick asks for guidance —
1) For deals that have active procurement counter-offers, should we show the nominal commit (AE ask) or the midline negotiated amount? Finance prefers conservative numbers but Sales sometimes wants the ask called out. My suggestion: include both numbers in the Exec Kit 1-pager ("ask / expected close"), and use the expected close for our internal commit tally.
2) If a deal has an outstanding SOC2 evidence request and the customer wants a longer retention period (legal risk flagged), should we drop it from the commit roll entirely or mark as contingent?

I'll also add one-page summaries for the three biggest potential commits and upload them to the Drive link once done.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

Folks — thanks for the quick turn. I pulled the updated checklist and assembled the Exec Kit. Highlights:
- Completed rollup attached (exec_kit_template.pdf) with 1-page rollup + 2-slide summaries for the three largest commits.
- I included both "AE ask" and "expected close" numbers on the one-pager and marked procurement or legal gates inline.
- Action items for BrightWave: Sara, can your procurement team confirm the PO timeline (we've noted "estimated: 2–4 weeks").

Next steps:
- Lukas: please route the attached packet to Finance and copy our CRO for a 9am PT sync on Fri if we need a quick pre-brief.
- Markus: please attach your one-pagers to the Drive link and confirm any gating language you want included.
- Grace: I'll pull the final commit tally and send the version to the exec list by Friday noon PT.

Attachments: exec_kit_template.pdf (pdf), brightwave_agenda_notes.txt (txt)

Lauren Bishop
